evidence.decision: Selects task style from completion semantics and checklist detail rather than visual density.
evidence.artifact: Requires task/chart/contact mappings plus reminder and permission behavior.
evidence.transformation: Recovery grid becomes a scheduled descriptive checklist with coalesced pending-plan reminders.
evidence.verification: Fails misrepresented completion, color-only task identity and misleading changed-permission data.
evidence.applicability: Keeps clinical content intact and separates iOS/iPad care UI, watch notifications and clinical efficacy.
evidence.handoffs: HealthKit handles data access; ResearchKit only when study/consent tasks are actually present.
evidence.distinctiveness: Scheduled care steps, event logging and care-role contacts create consequential domain decisions.
